paper.abstract_en: We investigate vacuum black-hole solutions in metric-affine Myrzakulov $F(R,T)$ gravity (MG-I), where $R$ is the affine Ricci scalar and $T$ is a quadratic torsion invariant, not the trace of the matter energy-momentum tensor. For the polynomial model $F(R,T)=αR+βT+γT^3$, with $α\neq0$, we first vary the metric and all components of the independent affine connection, and only then specialize to metric-compatible geometry with totally antisymmetric torsion. Nonzero axial torsion admits an exceptional branch $α+β+3γT_*^2=0$, on which the metric satisfies the Einstein equations with effective cosmological parameter $Λ_*=γT_*^3/α$. We establish a local existence result and construct torsionful Schwarzschild-(anti-)de Sitter representatives that are smooth through a selected future Killing horizon. Within the spherically symmetric axial ansatz, we characterize Ricci-symmetric affine connections by the condition $(fV-U)'=0$ and compare a constant-$W=fV-U$ family with a constant-$U$ family. Although these connections share the same metric and torsion scalar, their affine curvature invariants generally differ. Independent coordinate-level curvature contractions and component tests of the unrestricted metric and connection variations corroborate the identities used in the construction; these checks complement the analytic variational derivation. Finally, we identify null directions of the restricted axial quadratic form and distinguish this degeneracy from a complete metric-affine stability analysis. Our conclusions are local and do not establish global extendibility, physical inequivalence of all torsion profiles, or dynamical stability.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在度量-仿射Myrzakulov F(R,T)引力（MG-I）框架下研究真空黑洞解，R为仿射Ricci标量、T为二次挠率不变量；论文先对度规与独立仿射联络的全部分量变分，再专门化到度规相容且挠率全反对称的几何，构造带挠率的Schwarzschild-(反)de Sitter解并给出局部存在性结果，同时讨论限制性轴向二次型的零方向。主题与度量-仿射引力核心问题（独立联络、挠率、非度规性、超动量）高度契合，方法层次深、自述边界清晰，值得点击阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究度量-仿射 Myrzakulov $F(R,T)$ 引力（MG-I）中的真空黑洞解，其中 $R$ 是仿射 Ricci 标量，$T$ 是二次挠率不变量，而不是物质能量-动量张量的迹。对于多项式模型 $F(R,T)=\alpha R+\beta T+\gamma T^3$（$\alpha\neq0$），我们首先对度规以及独立仿射联络的所有分量作变分，然后才专门化到度规相容且挠率全反对称的几何。非零轴挠率允许一个例外分支 $\alpha+\beta+3\gamma T_*^2=0$，在该分支上度规满足带有有效宇宙学参数 $\Lambda_*=\gamma T_*^3/\alpha$ 的 Einstein 方程。我们建立了一个局部存在性结果，并构造了通过某一选定未来 Killing 视界光滑的带挠率 Schwarzschild-(反)de Sitter 代表解。在球对称轴向拟设下，我们以条件 $(fV-U)'=0$ 刻画 Ricci 对称仿射联络，并比较了常数 $W=fV-U$ 族与常数 $U$ 族。尽管这些联络共享相同的度规与挠率标量，它们的仿射曲率不变量一般不同。独立的坐标层面曲率缩并以及对无约束度规与联络变分的分量检验，佐证了构造中所用的恒等式；这些检验补充了解析变分推导。最后，我们指出限制性轴向二次型的零方向，并将这一退化性与完整的度量-仿射稳定性分析区分开来。我们的结论是局部的，并不确立全局可延拓性、所有挠率剖面的物理不等价性，或动力学稳定性。
